neighbours.label: the verb of possession 'have' (also Spanish tengo/tiene, German habe, and possessive 's) when it means having or lacking something
fire: Many older farmers still have no internet connection at home.
Lo siento, pero hoy no tengo dinero para el cine.
Our neighbours also have two dogs and a very noisy parrot.
Sadly, the clinic doesn't have enough nurses for the night shift.
Mein Bruder sagt, ich habe zu viele Bücher im Zimmer.
Most students have questions about the final exam.
Mi hermana tiene tres gatos y un perro pequeño.
Honestly, small towns often don't have a decent bookshop.
